sloka: श्रुत्वा तु गदितां वाचं राजर्षिगणपूजिताम् ।प्रत्यभाषत मां देवी बाष्पैः पिहितलोचना ।। ५.५८.९३ ।।।।
transliteration: śrutvā tu gaditāṁ vācaṁ rājarṣigaṇapūjitām ।pratyabhāṣata māṁ devī bāṣpaiḥ pihitalocanā ।। 5.58.93 ।।।।

translations.english: "O foremost of vanaras who are you? Why and how have you come here? How did you make friendship with Rama? Tell me all that in detail.
